# Only42Biryani

> Only42Biryani is a Hyderabad kitchen that makes one thing: Hyderabadi chicken dum biryani, cooked in a single fresh batch of 42 plates a day. When the 42 plates are gone, the kitchen stops.

## Key facts
- Product: Hyderabadi chicken dum biryani (medium-grain rice and fresh boneless chicken breast slow-cooked in a sealed handi). It is the only item on the menu.
- Chicken: fresh boneless chicken breast, sourced from Sneha chicken.
- Packaging: boxes made from sugarcane bagasse (the plant fibre left after sugarcane is pressed for juice).
- Limit: 42 plates per day, one batch, no second batch, no frozen gravy.
- City: Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
- Ordering: directly on the website (https://only42biryani.com/order) with cash or UPI on delivery, or on Zomato. When the kitchen is offline or sold out for the day, people can pre-book for another day. We deliver only inside Hyderabad.

## Pages
- [Home](https://only42biryani.com/): what Only42Biryani is, how it works, FAQ, and the waitlist.
- [Order](https://only42biryani.com/order): the product, price, delivery and payment details, and the order form.
- [Contact](https://only42biryani.com/contact): email, area and a form to request a call back.
- [Delivery policy](https://only42biryani.com/delivery-policy), [Refund policy](https://only42biryani.com/refund-policy), [Terms](https://only42biryani.com/terms) and [Privacy policy](https://only42biryani.com/privacy).
